subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 46

text: I am running for Congress to provide freedom and opportunity to all Americans.

I have a plan to improve affordability for working families, eliminate government fraud and waste, and reduce our national debt. We can accomplish all of these goals by phasing out our welfare and entitlement programs. The money saved, over $4 trillion per year, can pay every American $16,000 per year starting at age 21 and still reduce our budget deficit by over $1 trillion per year. Rather than have our money go into a massive government bureaucracy, we can invest this money in ourselves, giving all Americans the freedom to plan their own futures.
As an educator, I support the rights of parents and their choice of the best schools for their children, with success being measured in determination and excellence rather than accident of birth.
I support investing in more police and firefighters, enforcing our laws, and reforming our immigration system.

A son of immigrants from Taiwan, I was born in Chicago, received my B.A. from Stanford and my Ph.D. from Columbia. Having taught at UC Irvine since 2006, I also served on the U.S. State Department’s Commission on Unalienable Rights. I have been endorsed by the Orange County Congress of Republicans, the Republican Party of Orange County, the California Republican Party, and dozens of elected officials. I would be honored to receive your vote and work toward a better future for our district and for all Americans.
Please visit my website at davidpanforcongress.com.
